headline: Seattle Pacific alone still without a draw
dek: Seattle Pacific won at Dallas Baptist on Wednesday, their sixth win against a single defeat, and remain the only programme in the conference yet to share the points. The defeat came at Regis, where Western Washington drew on Sunday.
